@@ -0,0 +1,601 @@
+import io
+import json
+import re
+import sys
+from pathlib import Path
+from urllib.parse import urldefrag, urlparse
+
+from playwright.sync_api import sync_playwright
+
+
+sys.stdout = io.TextIOWrapper(sys.stdout.buffer, encoding="utf-8")
+
+BASE = "http://localhost:8000"
+ROOT = Path(__file__).resolve().parents[1]
+PUBLIC = [
+    "/index.html",
+    "/pages/ataskaitos.html",
+    "/pages/bendra-info.html",
+    "/pages/dirvezemis.html",
+    "/pages/gyvoji_gamta.html",
+    "/pages/oro.html",
+    "/pages/prenumerata.html",
+    "/pages/privatumo-politika.html",
+    "/pages/slapuku-politika.html",
+    "/pages/truksmas.html",
+    "/pages/vadovas.html",
+    "/pages/vanduo.html",
+    "/pages/zeldynai.html",
+    "/pages/zemelapis.html",
+]
+ADMIN = [
+    "/pages/admin/index.html",
+    "/pages/admin/prenumeratos.html",
+    "/pages/admin/pranesimai.html",
+    "/pages/admin/sla.html",
+    "/pages/admin/nevalidus.html",
+    "/pages/admin/auditas.html",
+    "/pages/admin/duomenys.html",
+    "/pages/admin/nustatymai.html",
+    "/pages/admin/patvirtinimas.html",
+]
+
+
+def wait_ready(page, delay=650):
+    page.wait_for_load_state("domcontentloaded")
+    try:
+        page.evaluate("document.fonts ? document.fonts.ready : Promise.resolve()")
+    except Exception:
+        pass
+    page.wait_for_timeout(delay)
+
+
+def login(page):
+    page.goto(BASE + "/pages/admin/login.html", wait_until="domcontentloaded")
+    page.evaluate("localStorage.clear()")
+    page.reload(wait_until="domcontentloaded")
+    page.fill("#login-username", "administratorius")
+    page.fill("#login-password", "admin")
+    page.click("#credentials-form button[type=submit]")
+    page.wait_for_timeout(150)
+    credential_focus = page.evaluate("document.activeElement && document.activeElement.id")
+    totp_visible = page.locator("#login-stage-totp").is_visible()
+    code = page.locator("#totp-code").inner_text().strip()
+    page.fill("#totp-input", code)
+    page.click("#totp-form button[type=submit]")
+    page.wait_for_url("**/pages/admin/index.html")
+    wait_ready(page)
+    return {
+        "totp_stage_visible": totp_visible,
+        "focus_after_credentials": credential_focus,
+        "landed": page.url,
+    }
+
+
+def color_tuple(value):
+    nums = [float(x) for x in re.findall(r"[\d.]+", value)]
+    if value.startswith("#"):
+        h = value.lstrip("#")
+        if len(h) == 3:
+            h = "".join(ch * 2 for ch in h)
+        return tuple(int(h[i:i + 2], 16) for i in (0, 2, 4))
+    if len(nums) >= 3:
+        return tuple(int(round(x)) for x in nums[:3])
+    raise ValueError(value)
+
+
+def contrast(a, b):
+    def luminance(value):
+        channels = []
+        for component in color_tuple(value):
+            channel = component / 255
+            channels.append(channel / 12.92 if channel <= 0.04045 else ((channel + 0.055) / 1.055) ** 2.4)
+        return 0.2126 * channels[0] + 0.7152 * channels[1] + 0.0722 * channels[2]
+    la, lb = luminance(a), luminance(b)
+    return round((max(la, lb) + 0.05) / (min(la, lb) + 0.05), 2)
+
+
+def control_audit(page):
+    return page.evaluate("""() => {
+      function visible(el) {
+        const cs = getComputedStyle(el);
+        const r = el.getBoundingClientRect();
+        return cs.display !== 'none' && cs.visibility !== 'hidden' && r.width > 0 && r.height > 0;
+      }
+      function name(el) {
+        const aria = (el.getAttribute('aria-label') || '').trim();
+        if (aria) return aria;
+        const refs = (el.getAttribute('aria-labelledby') || '').trim().split(/\s+/).filter(Boolean);
+        const refText = refs.map(id => document.getElementById(id)?.textContent?.trim() || '').join(' ').trim();
+        if (refText) return refText;
+        const labelText = [...(el.labels || [])].map(label => label.textContent.trim()).join(' ').trim();
+        if (labelText) return labelText;
+        if (el.tagName === 'BUTTON' && el.textContent.trim()) return el.textContent.trim();
+        if (el.type === 'submit' && el.value) return el.value;
+        return '';
+      }
+      return [...document.querySelectorAll('input, select, textarea, button')]
+        .filter(el => !el.inert && el.type !== 'hidden' && visible(el))
+        .filter(el => !name(el))
+        .map(el => ({tag: el.tagName, type: el.type || null, id: el.id || null, cls: el.className || null, html: el.outerHTML.slice(0, 180)}));
+    }""")
+
+
+def live_region_audit(page):
+    return page.evaluate("""() => {
+      const candidates = [...document.querySelectorAll('[data-role="status"], .analysis-message, .admin-form-message, #feed-status, [id$="-status"], [id$="-message"]')];
+      return candidates.map(el => ({
+        id: el.id || null,
+        role: el.getAttribute('role'),
+        live: el.getAttribute('aria-live'),
+        hidden: el.hidden,
+        text: el.textContent.trim().slice(0, 100),
+        announced: ['status','alert'].includes(el.getAttribute('role')) || !!el.getAttribute('aria-live')
+      }));
+    }""")
+
+
+def route_probe(page, route):
+    page.goto(BASE + route, wait_until="domcontentloaded")
+    wait_ready(page)
+    return {
+        "url": page.url,
+        "scroll_width": page.evaluate("document.documentElement.scrollWidth"),
+        "client_width": page.evaluate("document.documentElement.clientWidth"),
+        "fonts": page.evaluate("({available: !!document.fonts, status: document.fonts?.status || null, jakarta: document.fonts?.check('16px \"Plus Jakarta Sans\"') ?? null})"),
+        "unnamed_controls": control_audit(page),
+        "live_regions": live_region_audit(page),

+def contrast_checks(page):
+    page.goto(BASE + "/index.html", wait_until="domcontentloaded")
+    wait_ready(page)
+    values = page.evaluate("""() => {
+      const root = getComputedStyle(document.documentElement);
+      const names=['--ink-500','--surface','--surface-muted','--sea-950','--shore-100','--good','--fair','--moderate','--poor','--very-poor','--extremely-poor','--no-data','--status-ink','--ink-950'];
+      const tokens=Object.fromEntries(names.map(n=>[n,root.getPropertyValue(n).trim()]));
+      const holder=document.createElement('div'); holder.style.cssText='position:fixed;left:-9999px;top:0';
+      const classes=['status-good','status-fair','status-moderate','status-poor','status-very-poor','status-extremely-poor','status-no-data','admin-status-ok','admin-status-warn','admin-status-danger','admin-status-muted','protocol-chip'];
+      classes.forEach(c=>{const el=document.createElement('span');el.className=(c.startsWith('status-')?'status-chip ':'admin-chip ')+c;el.textContent=c;holder.append(el)});document.body.append(holder);
+      const pairs=[...holder.children].map(el=>({class:el.className,color:getComputedStyle(el).color,background:getComputedStyle(el).backgroundColor}));
+      holder.remove();
+      const footer=document.querySelector('.site-footer');const link=footer.querySelector('a');
+      return {tokens,pairs,footer:{color:getComputedStyle(link).color,background:getComputedStyle(footer).backgroundColor}};
+    }""")
+    page.hover(".site-footer a")
+    page.wait_for_timeout(240)
+    values["footer"]["hover"] = page.eval_on_selector(".site-footer a", "el=>getComputedStyle(el).color")
+    values["ratios"] = {
+        "ink500_surface": contrast(values["tokens"]["--ink-500"], values["tokens"]["--surface"]),
+        "ink500_surface_muted": contrast(values["tokens"]["--ink-500"], values["tokens"]["--surface-muted"]),
+        "footer": contrast(values["footer"]["color"], values["footer"]["background"]),
+        "footer_hover": contrast(values["footer"]["hover"], values["footer"]["background"]),
+    }
+    for pair in values["pairs"]:
+        values["ratios"][pair["class"]] = contrast(pair["color"], pair["background"])
+    return values

+def static_checks():
+    chart_files = [
+        ROOT / "demo/js/pages/analysis.js",
+        ROOT / "demo/js/pages/periodic.js",
+        ROOT / "demo/js/pages/greenery.js",
+        ROOT / "demo/js/pages/wildlife.js",
+        ROOT / "demo/js/pages/reports.js",
+    ]
+    chart_calls = []
+    imports = {}
+    for path in chart_files:
+        text = path.read_text(encoding="utf-8")
+        chart_calls.extend((str(path.relative_to(ROOT)), i, line.strip()) for i, line in enumerate(text.splitlines(), 1) if re.search(r"new\s+(?:window\.)?Chart\s*\(", line))
+        imports[str(path.relative_to(ROOT))] = "../charts/defaults.js" in text
+    color_files = chart_files + [ROOT / "demo/js/pages/map.js"]
+    hex_hits = []
+    for path in color_files:
+        for i, line in enumerate(path.read_text(encoding="utf-8").splitlines(), 1):
+            for value in re.findall(r"#[0-9a-fA-F]{3,8}\b", line):
+                hex_hits.append({"file": str(path.relative_to(ROOT)), "line": i, "value": value})
+    query = (ROOT / "demo/js/data/query.js").read_text(encoding="utf-8")
+    subscriptions = (ROOT / "demo/js/data/subscriptions.js").read_text(encoding="utf-8")
+    mapjs = (ROOT / "demo/js/pages/map.js").read_text(encoding="utf-8")
+    html_text = "\n".join(path.read_text(encoding="utf-8") for path in (ROOT / "demo").rglob("*.html"))
+    public_text = "\n".join(path.read_text(encoding="utf-8") for path in [ROOT / "demo" / route.lstrip("/") for route in PUBLIC])
+    clause_hits = []
+    for route in PUBLIC:
+        path = ROOT / "demo" / route.lstrip("/")
+        for i, line in enumerate(path.read_text(encoding="utf-8").splitlines(), 1):
+            values = re.findall(r"(?<!\d)(3\.\d+(?:\.\d+)*(?:[–-]3\.\d+(?:\.\d+)*)?)", line)
+            if values:
+                clause_hits.append({"file": str(path.relative_to(ROOT)), "line": i, "values": values})
+    return {
+        "chart_call_count": len(chart_calls),
+        "chart_calls": chart_calls,
+        "chart_default_imports": imports,
+        "raw_hex_occurrences": len(hex_hits),
+        "raw_hex_unique": sorted(set(hit["value"].lower() for hit in hex_hits)),
+        "raw_hex_hits": hex_hits,
+        "cache_limit_40": "QUERY_CACHE_LIMIT = 40" in query and "setCappedCache" in query,
+        "erase_log_cap_50": bool(re.search(r"slice\([^\n]*50", subscriptions) or re.search(r"length\s*>\s*50", subscriptions)),
+        "marker_diffing": all(token in mapjs for token in ["markersBySite", "removeLayer", "setLatLng"]),
+        "cdn_script_total": len(re.findall(r"<script[^>]+(?:cdn\.jsdelivr|unpkg)", html_text, re.I)),
+        "cdn_script_defer": len(re.findall(r"<script[^>]+defer[^>]+(?:cdn\.jsdelivr|unpkg)|<script[^>]+(?:cdn\.jsdelivr|unpkg)[^>]+defer", html_text, re.I)),
+        "public_clause_hits": clause_hits,
+        "kd_bad_count": len(re.findall(r"KD2,5", public_text)),
+        "kd_good_count": len(re.findall(r"KD 2,5", public_text)),
+    }
+
+
+def main():
+    result = {"runtime": {}, "accessibility": {}, "responsive": {}, "regressions": {}, "technical": {}}
+    with sync_playwright() as pw:
+        browser = pw.chromium.launch(headless=True)
+        desktop = browser.new_context(viewport={"width": 1440, "height": 900})
+        page = desktop.new_page()
+        runtime_errors = []
+        current_route = {"value": ""}
+        page.on("console", lambda msg: runtime_errors.append({"route": current_route["value"], "kind": "console:" + msg.type, "text": msg.text}) if msg.type == "error" else None)
+        page.on("pageerror", lambda error: runtime_errors.append({"route": current_route["value"], "kind": "pageerror", "text": str(error)}))
+
+        route_results = {}
+        all_refs = set()
+        for route in PUBLIC:
+            current_route["value"] = route
+            route_results[route] = route_probe(page, route)
+            all_refs.update(route_results[route].pop("refs"))
+
+        current_route["value"] = "/pages/admin/login.html"
+        login_result = login(page)
+        login_probe = {
+            "url": BASE + "/pages/admin/login.html",
+            "scroll_width": None,
+            "client_width": 1440,
+            "fonts": {"available": True},
+            "unnamed_controls": [],
+            "live_regions": [],
+        }
+        # Audit the login DOM itself in an isolated page so the authenticated redirect cannot hide it.
+        login_page = desktop.new_page()
+        login_page.goto(BASE + "/pages/admin/login.html", wait_until="domcontentloaded")
+        # Its shared storage redirects; clear and reload to expose the login page.
+        login_page.evaluate("localStorage.removeItem('kms_amis_admin_session')")
+        login_page.reload(wait_until="domcontentloaded")
+        wait_ready(login_page)
+        login_probe.update({
+            "scroll_width": login_page.evaluate("document.documentElement.scrollWidth"),
+            "client_width": login_page.evaluate("document.documentElement.clientWidth"),
+            "fonts": login_page.evaluate("({available:!!document.fonts,status:document.fonts?.status||null,jakarta:document.fonts?.check('16px \"Plus Jakarta Sans\"')??null})"),
+            "unnamed_controls": control_audit(login_page),
+            "live_regions": live_region_audit(login_page),
+        })
+        all_refs.update(login_page.evaluate("[...document.querySelectorAll('[href],[src]')].flatMap(el=>[el.href||el.src]).filter(Boolean)"))
+        login_page.close()
+        # Restore the authenticated session removed by the second page (same context).
+        page.goto(BASE + "/pages/admin/login.html", wait_until="domcontentloaded")
+        login_result = login(page)
+
+        admin_results = {"/pages/admin/login.html": login_probe}
+        for route in ADMIN:
+            current_route["value"] = route
+            admin_results[route] = route_probe(page, route)
+            all_refs.update(admin_results[route].pop("refs"))
+
+        internal = sorted({urldefrag(url)[0] for url in all_refs if urlparse(url).scheme in ("http", "https") and urlparse(url).netloc == "localhost:8000"})
+        statuses = []
+        for url in internal:
+            response = desktop.request.get(url)
+            statuses.append({"url": url, "status": response.status, "ok": response.ok})
+
+        result["runtime"] = {
+            "public_routes": len(PUBLIC),
+            "admin_routes_including_login": len(ADMIN) + 1,
+            "errors": runtime_errors,
+            "internal_ref_count": len(statuses),
+            "failed_refs": [item for item in statuses if not item["ok"]],
+            "login": login_result,
+            "public": route_results,
+            "admin": admin_results,
+        }
+        result["accessibility"].update({
+            "tabs": tab_checks(page),
+            "multiselect_keyboard": multiselect_keyboard(page),
+            "subscription_focus": subscription_focus(page),
+        })
+        result["regressions"]["deep_links"] = deep_links(page)
+        result["regressions"]["charts"] = chart_checks(page)
+        result["regressions"]["zoom"] = zoom_checks(page)
+        result["regressions"]["contrast"] = contrast_checks(page)
+
+        mobile = browser.new_context(viewport={"width": 390, "height": 844})
+        mpage = mobile.new_page()
+        mobile_errors = []
+        mobile_route = {"value": ""}
+        mpage.on("console", lambda msg: mobile_errors.append({"route": mobile_route["value"], "kind": "console:" + msg.type, "text": msg.text}) if msg.type == "error" else None)
+        mpage.on("pageerror", lambda error: mobile_errors.append({"route": mobile_route["value"], "kind": "pageerror", "text": str(error)}))
+        widths = {}
+        for route in PUBLIC:
+            mobile_route["value"] = route
+            probe = route_probe(mpage, route)
+            widths[route] = {"scroll": probe["scroll_width"], "client": probe["client_width"]}
+        mobile_route["value"] = "/pages/admin/login.html"
+        mpage.goto(BASE + "/pages/admin/login.html", wait_until="domcontentloaded")
+        mpage.evaluate("localStorage.clear()")
+        mpage.reload(wait_until="domcontentloaded")
+        wait_ready(mpage)
+        widths["/pages/admin/login.html"] = {"scroll": mpage.evaluate("document.documentElement.scrollWidth"), "client": mpage.evaluate("document.documentElement.clientWidth")}
+        mobile_login = login(mpage)
+        for route in ADMIN:
+            mobile_route["value"] = route
+            probe = route_probe(mpage, route)
+            widths[route] = {"scroll": probe["scroll_width"], "client": probe["client_width"]}
+        result["responsive"] = {
+            "widths_390": widths,
+            "overflows": {route: dims for route, dims in widths.items() if dims["scroll"] > dims["client"] + 1},
+            "mobile_errors": mobile_errors,
+            "mobile_login": mobile_login,
+            "nav": nav_checks(mpage),
+            "touch_targets": touch_targets(mpage),
+        }
+        mobile.close()
+        desktop.close()
+        browser.close()
+
+    result["technical"] = static_checks()
+    if "--summary" in sys.argv:
+        unnamed = []
+        unannounced = []
+        for scope in (result["runtime"]["public"], result["runtime"]["admin"]):
+            for route, data in scope.items():
+                unnamed.extend({"route": route, **item} for item in data["unnamed_controls"])

+            }
+            for route, data in result["regressions"]["charts"].items()
+        }
+        zoom_summary = {}
+        for route in ("vanduo", "oro"):

+                    "rowCount": len(item["rows"]),
+                }

+        summary = {

+                "adminRoutes": result["runtime"]["admin_routes_including_login"],
+                "errors": result["runtime"]["errors"],

+                "login": result["runtime"]["login"],
+                "fontFalseRoutes": [route for scope in (result["runtime"]["public"], result["runtime"]["admin"]) for route, data in scope.items() if data["fonts"].get("jakarta") is False],
+            },
+            "accessibility": {
+                "unnamed": unnamed,
+                "unannouncedCandidates": unannounced,
+                "tabs": result["accessibility"]["tabs"],
+                "multiselectKeyboard": result["accessibility"]["multiselect_keyboard"],
+                "subscriptionFocus": result["accessibility"]["subscription_focus"],
+            },
+            "responsive": result["responsive"],
+            "deepLinks": result["regressions"]["deep_links"],
+            "charts": chart_summary,
+            "zoom": {"indexMap": result["regressions"]["zoom"]["index_map"], "multiselect": zoom_summary},
+            "contrast": {"tokens": result["regressions"]["contrast"]["tokens"], "ratios": result["regressions"]["contrast"]["ratios"]},
+            "technical": result["technical"],
+        }
+        print(json.dumps(summary, ensure_ascii=False, indent=2, default=list))
+    else:
+        print(json.dumps(result, ensure_ascii=False, indent=2))
+
+
+if __name__ == "__main__":
+    main()

+def color_tuple(value):
+    nums = [float(x) for x in re.findall(r"[\d.]+", value)]
+    if value.startswith("#"):
+        h = value.lstrip("#")
+        if len(h) == 3:
+            h = "".join(ch * 2 for ch in h)
+        return tuple(int(h[i:i + 2], 16) for i in (0, 2, 4))
+    if len(nums) >= 3:
+        return tuple(int(round(x)) for x in nums[:3])
+    raise ValueError(value)
+
+
+def contrast(a, b):
+    def luminance(value):
+        channels = []
+        for component in color_tuple(value):
+            channel = component / 255
+            channels.append(channel / 12.92 if channel <= 0.04045 else ((channel + 0.055) / 1.055) ** 2.4)
+        return 0.2126 * channels[0] + 0.7152 * channels[1] + 0.0722 * channels[2]
+    la, lb = luminance(a), luminance(b)
+    return round((max(la, lb) + 0.05) / (min(la, lb) + 0.05), 2)
+
+
+def control_audit(page):

+      }
+      function name(el) {
+        const aria = (el.getAttribute('aria-label') || '').trim();
+        if (aria) return aria;
+        const refs = (el.getAttribute('aria-labelledby') || '').trim().split(/\s+/).filter(Boolean);
+        const refText = refs.map(id => document.getElementById(id)?.textContent?.trim() || '').join(' ').trim();
+        if (refText) return refText;
+        const labelText = [...(el.labels || [])].map(label => label.textContent.trim()).join(' ').trim();
+        if (labelText) return labelText;
+        if (el.tagName === 'BUTTON' && el.textContent.trim()) return el.textContent.trim();
+        if (el.type === 'submit' && el.value) return el.value;
+        return '';
+      }
+      return [...document.querySelectorAll('input, select, textarea, button')]
+        .filter(el => !el.inert && el.type !== 'hidden' && visible(el))
+        .filter(el => !name(el))
+        .map(el => ({tag: el.tagName, type: el.type || null, id: el.id || null, cls: el.className || null, html: el.outerHTML.slice(0, 180)}));
+    }""")

+def route_probe(page, route):

+    before = page.evaluate("document.activeElement.checked")

+import io
+import json
+import sys
+
+from playwright.sync_api import sync_playwright
+
+sys.stdout = io.TextIOWrapper(sys.stdout.buffer, encoding="utf-8")
+BASE = "http://localhost:8000"
+
+
+def wait(page):
+    page.wait_for_load_state("domcontentloaded")
+    page.wait_for_timeout(700)
+
+
+def login(page):
+    page.goto(BASE + "/pages/admin/login.html")
+    page.fill("#login-username", "administratorius")
+    page.fill("#login-password", "admin")
+    page.click("#credentials-form button")
+    page.wait_for_timeout(100)
+    page.fill("#totp-input", page.locator("#totp-code").inner_text())
+    page.click("#totp-form button")
+    page.wait_for_url("**/pages/admin/index.html")
+    wait(page)
+
+
+with sync_playwright() as pw:
+    browser = pw.chromium.launch(headless=True)
+    context = browser.new_context(viewport={"width": 390, "height": 844})
+    page = context.new_page()
+    page.goto(BASE + "/index.html")
+    page.evaluate("localStorage.clear()")
+    page.reload()
+    wait(page)
+    home = page.evaluate("""() => ({
+      aqiText: document.querySelector('.aqi-layout')?.innerText,
+      footerHref: document.querySelector('.footer-links a')?.href
+    })""")
+
+    page.goto(BASE + "/pages/prenumerata.html")
+    wait(page)
+    page.locator('[data-check-group="districts"]').first.check()
+    page.click("#to-confirm")
+    page.fill("#subscription-email", "audit2@example.lt")
+    page.check('[name="consent"]')
+    page.click('#subscription-form button[type="submit"]')
+    code = page.locator("#demo-code").inner_text().strip("[]")
+    page.fill("#verify-code", code)
+    page.click('#verify-form button[type="submit"]')
+    stored = page.evaluate("JSON.parse(localStorage.getItem('kms-amis-demo-subscriptions-v1'))")
+
+    login(page)
+    page.goto(BASE + "/pages/admin/prenumeratos.html")
+    wait(page)
+    row = page.locator("#subscriber-table tr", has_text="audit2@example.lt")
+    subscription = {
+        "stored_status": stored[0]["status"],
+        "admin_row_found": row.count(),
+        "admin_status": row.locator(".admin-chip").inner_text() if row.count() else None,
+    }
+    page.goto(BASE + "/pages/admin/index.html")
+    wait(page)
+    subscription["dashboard_kpi"] = page.locator("#kpi-subscribers").inner_text()
+
+    overflow = {}
+    for name in ["index", "sla"]:
+        page.goto(BASE + f"/pages/admin/{name}.html")
+        wait(page)
+        overflow[name] = page.evaluate("""() => {
+          const vw=document.documentElement.clientWidth;
+          const boxes={};
+          ['body','.admin-layout','.admin-sidebar','.admin-workspace','.admin-topbar','.admin-main','.admin-kpi-grid','.admin-grid-2','.admin-stack','.data-table-wrap','.admin-table','table','.surface','.admin-nav'].forEach(sel=>{
+            boxes[sel]=[...document.querySelectorAll(sel)].slice(0,4).map(el=>{const r=el.getBoundingClientRect();return {left:Math.round(r.left),right:Math.round(r.right),width:Math.round(r.width),scrollW:el.scrollWidth,clientW:el.clientWidth,overflowX:getComputedStyle(el).overflowX,minWidth:getComputedStyle(el).minWidth};});
+          });
+          const items=[...document.querySelectorAll('body *')].filter(el=>{
+            const cs=getComputedStyle(el),r=el.getBoundingClientRect();
+            return cs.display!=='none' && r.width>0 && (r.right>vw+1 || r.left<-1);
+          }).map(el=>{const r=el.getBoundingClientRect();return {tag:el.tagName,id:el.id||null,cls:String(el.className||'').slice(0,100),left:Math.round(r.left),right:Math.round(r.right),width:Math.round(r.width),scrollW:el.scrollWidth,clientW:el.clientWidth,overflowX:getComputedStyle(el).overflowX};});
+          return {doc:[document.documentElement.scrollWidth,vw], boxes, offenders:items.sort((a,b)=>b.right-a.right).slice(0,8)};
+        }""")
+    print(json.dumps({"home": home, "subscription": subscription, "overflow": overflow}, ensure_ascii=False, indent=2))

+ROOT = Path(__file__).resolve().parents[1]

+    "/pages/ataskaitos.html",

+    "/pages/dirvezemis.html",
+    "/pages/gyvoji_gamta.html",
+    "/pages/oro.html",
+    "/pages/prenumerata.html",
+    "/pages/privatumo-politika.html",
+    "/pages/slapuku-politika.html",
+    "/pages/truksmas.html",
+    "/pages/vadovas.html",
+    "/pages/vanduo.html",
+    "/pages/zeldynai.html",

+    "/pages/admin/sla.html",
+    "/pages/admin/nevalidus.html",

+    "/pages/admin/nustatymai.html",
+    "/pages/admin/patvirtinimas.html",

+
+def wait_ready(page, delay=650):
+    page.wait_for_load_state("domcontentloaded")
+    try:
+        page.evaluate("document.fonts ? document.fonts.ready : Promise.resolve()")
+    except Exception:
+        pass
+    page.wait_for_timeout(delay)
+
+
+def login(page):
+    page.goto(BASE + "/pages/admin/login.html", wait_until="domcontentloaded")
+    page.evaluate("localStorage.clear()")
+    page.reload(wait_until="domcontentloaded")
+    page.fill("#login-username", "administratorius")
+    page.fill("#login-password", "admin")
+    page.click("#credentials-form button[type=submit]")
+    page.wait_for_timeout(150)

+def color_tuple(value):
+    nums = [float(x) for x in re.findall(r"[\d.]+", value)]
+    if value.startswith("#"):
+        h = value.lstrip("#")
+        if len(h) == 3:
+            h = "".join(ch * 2 for ch in h)
+        return tuple(int(h[i:i + 2], 16) for i in (0, 2, 4))
+    if len(nums) >= 3:
+        return tuple(int(round(x)) for x in nums[:3])
+    raise ValueError(value)
+
+
+def contrast(a, b):
+    def luminance(value):
+        channels = []
+        for component in color_tuple(value):
+            channel = component / 255
+            channels.append(channel / 12.92 if channel <= 0.04045 else ((channel + 0.055) / 1.055) ** 2.4)
+        return 0.2126 * channels[0] + 0.7152 * channels[1] + 0.0722 * channels[2]
+    la, lb = luminance(a), luminance(b)
+    return round((max(la, lb) + 0.05) / (min(la, lb) + 0.05), 2)
+

+def control_audit(page):
+    return page.evaluate("""() => {
+      function visible(el) {
+        const cs = getComputedStyle(el);
+        const r = el.getBoundingClientRect();
+        return cs.display !== 'none' && cs.visibility !== 'hidden' && r.width > 0 && r.height > 0;
+      }
+      function name(el) {
+        const aria = (el.getAttribute('aria-label') || '').trim();
+        if (aria) return aria;
+        const refs = (el.getAttribute('aria-labelledby') || '').trim().split(/\s+/).filter(Boolean);
+        const refText = refs.map(id => document.getElementById(id)?.textContent?.trim() || '').join(' ').trim();
+        if (refText) return refText;
+        const labelText = [...(el.labels || [])].map(label => label.textContent.trim()).join(' ').trim();
+        if (labelText) return labelText;
+        if (el.tagName === 'BUTTON' && el.textContent.trim()) return el.textContent.trim();
+        if (el.type === 'submit' && el.value) return el.value;
+        return '';
+      }
+      return [...document.querySelectorAll('input, select, textarea, button')]
+        .filter(el => !el.inert && el.type !== 'hidden' && visible(el))
+        .filter(el => !name(el))
+        .map(el => ({tag: el.tagName, type: el.type || null, id: el.id || null, cls: el.className || null, html: el.outerHTML.slice(0, 180)}));
+    }""")
+
+
+def live_region_audit(page):
+    return page.evaluate("""() => {
+      const candidates = [...document.querySelectorAll('[data-role="status"], .analysis-message, .admin-form-message, #feed-status, [id$="-status"], [id$="-message"]')];
+      return candidates.map(el => ({
+        id: el.id || null,
+        role: el.getAttribute('role'),
+        live: el.getAttribute('aria-live'),
+        hidden: el.hidden,
+        text: el.textContent.trim().slice(0, 100),
+        announced: ['status','alert'].includes(el.getAttribute('role')) || !!el.getAttribute('aria-live')
+      }));
+    }""")

+def static_checks():
+    chart_files = [
+        ROOT / "demo/js/pages/analysis.js",
+        ROOT / "demo/js/pages/periodic.js",
+        ROOT / "demo/js/pages/greenery.js",
+        ROOT / "demo/js/pages/wildlife.js",
+        ROOT / "demo/js/pages/reports.js",
+    ]
+    chart_calls = []
+    imports = {}
+    for path in chart_files:
+        text = path.read_text(encoding="utf-8")
+        chart_calls.extend((str(path.relative_to(ROOT)), i, line.strip()) for i, line in enumerate(text.splitlines(), 1) if re.search(r"new\s+(?:window\.)?Chart\s*\(", line))
+        imports[str(path.relative_to(ROOT))] = "../charts/defaults.js" in text
+    color_files = chart_files + [ROOT / "demo/js/pages/map.js"]
+    hex_hits = []
+    for path in color_files:
+        for i, line in enumerate(path.read_text(encoding="utf-8").splitlines(), 1):
+            for value in re.findall(r"#[0-9a-fA-F]{3,8}\b", line):
+                hex_hits.append({"file": str(path.relative_to(ROOT)), "line": i, "value": value})
+    query = (ROOT / "demo/js/data/query.js").read_text(encoding="utf-8")
+    subscriptions = (ROOT / "demo/js/data/subscriptions.js").read_text(encoding="utf-8")
+    mapjs = (ROOT / "demo/js/pages/map.js").read_text(encoding="utf-8")
+    html_text = "\n".join(path.read_text(encoding="utf-8") for path in (ROOT / "demo").rglob("*.html"))
+    public_text = "\n".join(path.read_text(encoding="utf-8") for path in [ROOT / "demo" / route.lstrip("/") for route in PUBLIC])
+    clause_hits = []
+    for route in PUBLIC:
+        path = ROOT / "demo" / route.lstrip("/")
+        for i, line in enumerate(path.read_text(encoding="utf-8").splitlines(), 1):
+            values = re.findall(r"(?<!\d)(3\.\d+(?:\.\d+)*(?:[–-]3\.\d+(?:\.\d+)*)?)", line)
+            if values:
+                clause_hits.append({"file": str(path.relative_to(ROOT)), "line": i, "values": values})
+    return {
+        "chart_call_count": len(chart_calls),
+        "chart_calls": chart_calls,
+        "chart_default_imports": imports,
+        "raw_hex_occurrences": len(hex_hits),
+        "raw_hex_unique": sorted(set(hit["value"].lower() for hit in hex_hits)),
+        "raw_hex_hits": hex_hits,
+        "cache_limit_40": "QUERY_CACHE_LIMIT = 40" in query and "setCappedCache" in query,
+        "erase_log_cap_50": bool(re.search(r"slice\([^\n]*50", subscriptions) or re.search(r"length\s*>\s*50", subscriptions)),
+        "marker_diffing": all(token in mapjs for token in ["markersBySite", "removeLayer", "setLatLng"]),
+        "cdn_script_total": len(re.findall(r"<script[^>]+(?:cdn\.jsdelivr|unpkg)", html_text, re.I)),
+        "cdn_script_defer": len(re.findall(r"<script[^>]+defer[^>]+(?:cdn\.jsdelivr|unpkg)|<script[^>]+(?:cdn\.jsdelivr|unpkg)[^>]+defer", html_text, re.I)),
+        "public_clause_hits": clause_hits,
+        "kd_bad_count": len(re.findall(r"KD2,5", public_text)),
+        "kd_good_count": len(re.findall(r"KD 2,5", public_text)),
+    }
+
+
+def main():
+    result = {"runtime": {}, "accessibility": {}, "responsive": {}, "regressions": {}, "technical": {}}
+    with sync_playwright() as pw:
+        browser = pw.chromium.launch(headless=True)
+        desktop = browser.new_context(viewport={"width": 1440, "height": 900})
+        page = desktop.new_page()
+        runtime_errors = []
+        current_route = {"value": ""}
+        page.on("console", lambda msg: runtime_errors.append({"route": current_route["value"], "kind": "console:" + msg.type, "text": msg.text}) if msg.type == "error" else None)
+        page.on("pageerror", lambda error: runtime_errors.append({"route": current_route["value"], "kind": "pageerror", "text": str(error)}))
+
+        route_results = {}
+        all_refs = set()
+        for route in PUBLIC:
+            current_route["value"] = route
+            route_results[route] = route_probe(page, route)
+            all_refs.update(route_results[route].pop("refs"))
+
+        current_route["value"] = "/pages/admin/login.html"
+        login_result = login(page)
+        login_probe = {
+            "url": BASE + "/pages/admin/login.html",
+            "scroll_width": None,
+            "client_width": 1440,
+            "fonts": {"available": True},
+            "unnamed_controls": [],
+            "live_regions": [],
+        }
+        # Audit the login DOM itself in an isolated page so the authenticated redirect cannot hide it.
+        login_page = desktop.new_page()
+        login_page.goto(BASE + "/pages/admin/login.html", wait_until="domcontentloaded")
+        # Its shared storage redirects; clear and reload to expose the login page.
+        login_page.evaluate("localStorage.removeItem('kms_amis_admin_session')")
+        login_page.reload(wait_until="domcontentloaded")
+        wait_ready(login_page)
+        login_probe.update({
+            "scroll_width": login_page.evaluate("document.documentElement.scrollWidth"),
+            "client_width": login_page.evaluate("document.documentElement.clientWidth"),
+            "fonts": login_page.evaluate("({available:!!document.fonts,status:document.fonts?.status||null,jakarta:document.fonts?.check('16px \"Plus Jakarta Sans\"')??null})"),
+            "unnamed_controls": control_audit(login_page),
+            "live_regions": live_region_audit(login_page),
+        })
+        all_refs.update(login_page.evaluate("[...document.querySelectorAll('[href],[src]')].flatMap(el=>[el.href||el.src]).filter(Boolean)"))
+        login_page.close()
+        # Restore the authenticated session removed by the second page (same context).
+        page.goto(BASE + "/pages/admin/login.html", wait_until="domcontentloaded")
+        login_result = login(page)
+
+        admin_results = {"/pages/admin/login.html": login_probe}
+        for route in ADMIN:
+            current_route["value"] = route
+            admin_results[route] = route_probe(page, route)
+            all_refs.update(admin_results[route].pop("refs"))
+
+        internal = sorted({urldefrag(url)[0] for url in all_refs if urlparse(url).scheme in ("http", "https") and urlparse(url).netloc == "localhost:8000"})
+        statuses = []
+        for url in internal:
+            response = desktop.request.get(url)
+            statuses.append({"url": url, "status": response.status, "ok": response.ok})
+
+        result["runtime"] = {
+            "public_routes": len(PUBLIC),
+            "admin_routes_including_login": len(ADMIN) + 1,
+            "errors": runtime_errors,
+            "internal_ref_count": len(statuses),
+            "failed_refs": [item for item in statuses if not item["ok"]],
+            "login": login_result,
+            "public": route_results,
+            "admin": admin_results,
+        }
+        result["accessibility"].update({
+            "tabs": tab_checks(page),
+            "multiselect_keyboard": multiselect_keyboard(page),
+            "subscription_focus": subscription_focus(page),
+        })
+        result["regressions"]["deep_links"] = deep_links(page)
+        result["regressions"]["charts"] = chart_checks(page)
+        result["regressions"]["zoom"] = zoom_checks(page)
+        result["regressions"]["contrast"] = contrast_checks(page)
+
+        mobile = browser.new_context(viewport={"width": 390, "height": 844})
+        mpage = mobile.new_page()
+        mobile_errors = []
+        mobile_route = {"value": ""}
+        mpage.on("console", lambda msg: mobile_errors.append({"route": mobile_route["value"], "kind": "console:" + msg.type, "text": msg.text}) if msg.type == "error" else None)
+        mpage.on("pageerror", lambda error: mobile_errors.append({"route": mobile_route["value"], "kind": "pageerror", "text": str(error)}))
+        widths = {}
+        for route in PUBLIC:
+            mobile_route["value"] = route
+            probe = route_probe(mpage, route)
+            widths[route] = {"scroll": probe["scroll_width"], "client": probe["client_width"]}
+        mobile_route["value"] = "/pages/admin/login.html"
+        mpage.goto(BASE + "/pages/admin/login.html", wait_until="domcontentloaded")
+        mpage.evaluate("localStorage.clear()")
+        mpage.reload(wait_until="domcontentloaded")
+        wait_ready(mpage)
+        widths["/pages/admin/login.html"] = {"scroll": mpage.evaluate("document.documentElement.scrollWidth"), "client": mpage.evaluate("document.documentElement.clientWidth")}
+        mobile_login = login(mpage)
+        for route in ADMIN:
+            mobile_route["value"] = route
+            probe = route_probe(mpage, route)
+            widths[route] = {"scroll": probe["scroll_width"], "client": probe["client_width"]}
+        result["responsive"] = {
+            "widths_390": widths,
+            "overflows": {route: dims for route, dims in widths.items() if dims["scroll"] > dims["client"] + 1},
+            "mobile_errors": mobile_errors,
+            "mobile_login": mobile_login,
+            "nav": nav_checks(mpage),
+            "touch_targets": touch_targets(mpage),
+        }
+        mobile.close()
+        desktop.close()
+        browser.close()
+
+    result["technical"] = static_checks()
+    if "--summary" in sys.argv:
+        unnamed = []
+        unannounced = []
+        for scope in (result["runtime"]["public"], result["runtime"]["admin"]):
+            for route, data in scope.items():
+                unnamed.extend({"route": route, **item} for item in data["unnamed_controls"])
+                unannounced.extend({"route": route, **item} for item in data["live_regions"] if not item["announced"])
+        chart_summary = {
+            route: {
+                "chartGlobal": data["chartGlobal"],
+                "canvasCount": len(data["canvases"]),
+                "allReady": all(item["ready"] for item in data["canvases"]),
+                "themes": sorted({(item["family"], item["tooltipBackground"], item["yTick"], item["yGrid"]) for item in data["canvases"] if item["ready"]}),
+            }
+            for route, data in result["regressions"]["charts"].items()
+        }
+        zoom_summary = {}
+        for route in ("vanduo", "oro"):
+            zoom_summary[route] = [
+                {
+                    "id": item["id"],
+                    "rootOverflow": item["root"]["scrollW"] > item["root"]["clientW"] + 1,
+                    "listOverflow": item["list"]["scrollW"] > item["list"]["clientW"] + 1,
+                    "rowOverflowCount": sum(1 for row in item["rows"] if row["scrollW"] > row["clientW"] + 1 or row["textScrollW"] > row["textClientW"] + 1 or row["textScrollH"] > row["textClientH"] + 1),
+                    "rowCount": len(item["rows"]),
+                }
+                for item in result["regressions"]["zoom"][route]
+            ]
+        summary = {
+            "runtime": {
+                "publicRoutes": result["runtime"]["public_routes"],
+                "adminRoutes": result["runtime"]["admin_routes_including_login"],
+                "errors": result["runtime"]["errors"],
+                "internalRefs": result["runtime"]["internal_ref_count"],
+                "failedRefs": result["runtime"]["failed_refs"],
+                "login": result["runtime"]["login"],
+                "fontFalseRoutes": [route for scope in (result["runtime"]["public"], result["runtime"]["admin"]) for route, data in scope.items() if data["fonts"].get("jakarta") is False],
+            },
+            "accessibility": {
+                "unnamed": unnamed,
+                "unannouncedCandidates": unannounced,
+                "tabs": result["accessibility"]["tabs"],
+                "multiselectKeyboard": result["accessibility"]["multiselect_keyboard"],
+                "subscriptionFocus": result["accessibility"]["subscription_focus"],
+            },
+            "responsive": result["responsive"],
+            "deepLinks": result["regressions"]["deep_links"],
+            "charts": chart_summary,
+            "zoom": {"indexMap": result["regressions"]["zoom"]["index_map"], "multiselect": zoom_summary},
+            "contrast": {"tokens": result["regressions"]["contrast"]["tokens"], "ratios": result["regressions"]["contrast"]["ratios"]},
+            "technical": result["technical"],
+        }
+        print(json.dumps(summary, ensure_ascii=False, indent=2, default=list))
+    else:
+        print(json.dumps(result, ensure_ascii=False, indent=2))
+
+
+if __name__ == "__main__":
+    main()

+import io
+import json
+import sys
+
+from playwright.sync_api import sync_playwright
+
+sys.stdout = io.TextIOWrapper(sys.stdout.buffer, encoding="utf-8")
+BASE = "http://localhost:8000"
+
+
+def wait(page):
+    page.wait_for_load_state("domcontentloaded")
+    page.wait_for_timeout(700)
+
+
+def login(page):
+    page.goto(BASE + "/pages/admin/login.html")
+    page.fill("#login-username", "administratorius")
+    page.fill("#login-password", "admin")
+    page.click("#credentials-form button")
+    page.wait_for_timeout(100)
+    page.fill("#totp-input", page.locator("#totp-code").inner_text())
+    page.click("#totp-form button")
+    page.wait_for_url("**/pages/admin/index.html")
+    wait(page)
+
+
+with sync_playwright() as pw:
+    browser = pw.chromium.launch(headless=True)
+    context = browser.new_context(viewport={"width": 390, "height": 844})
+    page = context.new_page()
+    page.goto(BASE + "/index.html")
+    page.evaluate("localStorage.clear()")
+    page.reload()
+    wait(page)
+    home = page.evaluate("""() => ({
+      aqiText: document.querySelector('.aqi-layout')?.innerText,
+      footerHref: document.querySelector('.footer-links a')?.href
+    })""")
+
+    page.goto(BASE + "/pages/prenumerata.html")
+    wait(page)
+    page.locator('[data-check-group="districts"]').first.check()
+    page.click("#to-confirm")
+    page.fill("#subscription-email", "audit2@example.lt")
+    page.check('[name="consent"]')
+    page.click('#subscription-form button[type="submit"]')
+    code = page.locator("#demo-code").inner_text().strip("[]")
+    page.fill("#verify-code", code)
+    page.click('#verify-form button[type="submit"]')
+    stored = page.evaluate("JSON.parse(localStorage.getItem('kms-amis-demo-subscriptions-v1'))")
+
+    login(page)
+    page.goto(BASE + "/pages/admin/prenumeratos.html")
+    wait(page)
+    row = page.locator("#subscriber-table tr", has_text="audit2@example.lt")
+    subscription = {
+        "stored_status": stored[0]["status"],
+        "admin_row_found": row.count(),
+        "admin_status": row.locator(".admin-chip").inner_text() if row.count() else None,
+    }
+    page.goto(BASE + "/pages/admin/index.html")
+    wait(page)
+    subscription["dashboard_kpi"] = page.locator("#kpi-subscribers").inner_text()
+
+    overflow = {}
+    for name in ["index", "sla"]:
+        page.goto(BASE + f"/pages/admin/{name}.html")
+        wait(page)
+        overflow[name] = page.evaluate("""() => {
+          const vw=document.documentElement.clientWidth;
+          const boxes={};
+          ['body','.admin-layout','.admin-sidebar','.admin-workspace','.admin-topbar','.admin-main','.admin-kpi-grid','.admin-grid-2','.admin-stack','.data-table-wrap','.admin-table','table','.surface','.admin-nav'].forEach(sel=>{
+            boxes[sel]=[...document.querySelectorAll(sel)].slice(0,4).map(el=>{const r=el.getBoundingClientRect();return {left:Math.round(r.left),right:Math.round(r.right),width:Math.round(r.width),scrollW:el.scrollWidth,clientW:el.clientWidth,overflowX:getComputedStyle(el).overflowX,minWidth:getComputedStyle(el).minWidth};});
+          });
+          const items=[...document.querySelectorAll('body *')].filter(el=>{
+            const cs=getComputedStyle(el),r=el.getBoundingClientRect();
+            return cs.display!=='none' && r.width>0 && (r.right>vw+1 || r.left<-1);
+          }).map(el=>{const r=el.getBoundingClientRect();return {tag:el.tagName,id:el.id||null,cls:String(el.className||'').slice(0,100),left:Math.round(r.left),right:Math.round(r.right),width:Math.round(r.width),scrollW:el.scrollWidth,clientW:el.clientWidth,overflowX:getComputedStyle(el).overflowX};});
+          return {doc:[document.documentElement.scrollWidth,vw], boxes, offenders:items.sort((a,b)=>b.right-a.right).slice(0,8)};
+        }""")
+    print(json.dumps({"home": home, "subscription": subscription, "overflow": overflow}, ensure_ascii=False, indent=2))
+    browser.close()

+def wait_ready(page, delay=650):
+    page.wait_for_load_state("domcontentloaded")
+    try:
+        page.evaluate("document.fonts ? document.fonts.ready : Promise.resolve()")
+    except Exception:
+        pass
+    page.wait_for_timeout(delay)

+
+def login(page):
+    page.goto(BASE + "/pages/admin/login.html", wait_until="domcontentloaded")
+    page.evaluate("localStorage.clear()")
+    page.reload(wait_until="domcontentloaded")
+    page.fill("#login-username", "administratorius")
+    page.fill("#login-password", "admin")
+    page.click("#credentials-form button[type=submit]")
+    page.wait_for_timeout(150)
+    credential_focus = page.evaluate("document.activeElement && document.activeElement.id")

+        "totp_stage_visible": totp_visible,
+        "focus_after_credentials": credential_focus,

+    }

+
+def color_tuple(value):
+    nums = [float(x) for x in re.findall(r"[\d.]+", value)]
+    if value.startswith("#"):
+        h = value.lstrip("#")
+        if len(h) == 3:
+            h = "".join(ch * 2 for ch in h)
+        return tuple(int(h[i:i + 2], 16) for i in (0, 2, 4))
+    if len(nums) >= 3:
+        return tuple(int(round(x)) for x in nums[:3])
+    raise ValueError(value)
+
+
+def contrast(a, b):
+    def luminance(value):
+        channels = []
+        for component in color_tuple(value):
+            channel = component / 255
+            channels.append(channel / 12.92 if channel <= 0.04045 else ((channel + 0.055) / 1.055) ** 2.4)
+        return 0.2126 * channels[0] + 0.7152 * channels[1] + 0.0722 * channels[2]
+    la, lb = luminance(a), luminance(b)
+    return round((max(la, lb) + 0.05) / (min(la, lb) + 0.05), 2)
+
+
+def control_audit(page):
+    return page.evaluate("""() => {
+      function visible(el) {
+        const cs = getComputedStyle(el);
+        const r = el.getBoundingClientRect();
+        return cs.display !== 'none' && cs.visibility !== 'hidden' && r.width > 0 && r.height > 0;
+      }
+      function name(el) {
+        const aria = (el.getAttribute('aria-label') || '').trim();
+        if (aria) return aria;
+        const refs = (el.getAttribute('aria-labelledby') || '').trim().split(/\s+/).filter(Boolean);
+        const refText = refs.map(id => document.getElementById(id)?.textContent?.trim() || '').join(' ').trim();
+        if (refText) return refText;
+        const labelText = [...(el.labels || [])].map(label => label.textContent.trim()).join(' ').trim();
+        if (labelText) return labelText;
+        if (el.tagName === 'BUTTON' && el.textContent.trim()) return el.textContent.trim();
+        if (el.type === 'submit' && el.value) return el.value;
+        return '';
+      }
+      return [...document.querySelectorAll('input, select, textarea, button')]
+        .filter(el => !el.inert && el.type !== 'hidden' && visible(el))
+        .filter(el => !name(el))
+        .map(el => ({tag: el.tagName, type: el.type || null, id: el.id || null, cls: el.className || null, html: el.outerHTML.slice(0, 180)}));
+    }""")
+
+
+def live_region_audit(page):

+
+

+
+def contrast_checks(page):

+      const names=['--ink-500','--surface','--surface-muted','--sea-950','--shore-100','--good','--fair','--moderate','--poor','--very-poor','--extremely-poor','--no-data','--status-ink','--ink-950'];
+      const tokens=Object.fromEntries(names.map(n=>[n,root.getPropertyValue(n).trim()]));
+      const holder=document.createElement('div'); holder.style.cssText='position:fixed;left:-9999px;top:0';

+    page.click("#totp-form button")
+    page.wait_for_url("**/pages/admin/index.html")
+    wait(page)

+

+    page.reload()
+    wait(page)
+    home = page.evaluate("""() => ({

+      footerHref: document.querySelector('.footer-links a')?.href

+
+    page.goto(BASE + "/pages/prenumerata.html")

+    page.fill("#verify-code", code)
+    page.click('#verify-form button[type="submit"]')
+    stored = page.evaluate("JSON.parse(localStorage.getItem('kms-amis-demo-subscriptions-v1'))")
+
+    login(page)
+    page.goto(BASE + "/pages/admin/prenumeratos.html")
+    wait(page)
+    row = page.locator("#subscriber-table tr", has_text="audit2@example.lt")
+    subscription = {
+        "stored_status": stored[0]["status"],
+        "admin_row_found": row.count(),
+        "admin_status": row.locator(".admin-chip").inner_text() if row.count() else None,

+    page.goto(BASE + "/pages/admin/index.html")
+    wait(page)
+    subscription["dashboard_kpi"] = page.locator("#kpi-subscribers").inner_text()

254	.admin-login-card { width: min(100%, 500px); padding: clamp(23px, 5vw, 42px); background: var(--surface); border: 1px solid var(--line); box-shadow: var(--shadow-md); }
255	.admin-login-card h1 { margin-top: 16px; font-size: clamp(2rem, 5vw, 3.7rem); }
256	.admin-login-card .lede { margin: 10px 0 24px; font-size: .85rem; }
257	.admin-login-brand { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 11px; color: var(--sea-950); text-decoration: none; }
258	.admin-login-brand .brand-mark { color: var(--sea-900); }
259	.admin-login-brand strong { font-size: .91rem; font-weight: 600; }
260	.admin-login-brand small { display: block; margin-top: 4px; color: var(--ink-600); font-size: .65rem; letter-spacing: .08em; text-transform: uppercase; }
261	.login-stage[hidden], .admin-page[hidden] { display: none; }
262	.totp-panel { margin: 16px 0; padding: 13px; background: var(--shore-100); border: 1px solid var(--shore-300); }
263	.totp-panel p { margin: 0; color: var(--land-900); font-size: .72rem; }
264	.totp-code { display: block; margin-top: 6px; color: var(--sea-950); font-family: ui-monospace, SFMono-Regular, Consolas, monospace; font-size: 1.4rem; font-weight: 600; letter-spacing: .14em; }
265	.totp-progress { height: 5px; margin-top: 10px; overflow: hidden; background: var(--surface); }
266	.totp-progress span { display: block; height: 100%; background: var(--land-500); transform-origin: left; }
267	.login-help { margin: 19px 0 0; color: var(--ink-500); font-size: .67rem; }
268	.admin-refusal { margin-top: 20px; }
269	.admin-refusal h1 { margin: 8px 0; font-size: 2.3rem; }
270	.admin-refusal p { max-width: 52ch; color: var(--ink-600); font-size: .82rem; }
271	.admin-toast-region { position: fixed; right: 20px; bottom: 20px; z-index: 1000; display: grid; gap: 8px; width: min(360px, calc(100vw - 40px)); }
272	.admin-toast { padding: 12px 14px; color: var(--ink-800); background: var(--surface); border: 1px solid var(--line); border-left: 3px solid var(--land-700); box-shadow: var(--shadow-md); font-size: .72rem; animation: admin-toast-in 260ms var(--ease-out); }
273	.admin-toast--error { border-left-color: var(--poor); }
274	@keyframes admin-toast-in { from { opacity: 0; transform: translateY(8px); } to { opacity: 1; transform: translateY(0); } }
275	.banner-preview { display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: space-between; gap: 10px; padding: 11px 13px; color: var(--ink-800); background: var(--shore-100); border-left: 3px solid var(--sun-500); font-size: .73rem; }
276	.sla-countdown { white-space: nowrap; }
277	.sla-countdown.is-late { color: #a13e00; }
278	.sla-countdown.is-ok { color: var(--land-900); }
279	.portal-banner-region { width: min(calc(100% - 40px), var(--content-max)); margin: 16px auto -10px; }
280	.portal-banner { display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: space-between; gap: 14px; }
281	.portal-banner .button { flex: 0 0 auto; }
282	@media (max-width: 1100px) { .admin-layout { grid-template-columns: 220px minmax(0, 1fr); } .admin-grid-2, .admin-grid-3 { grid-template-columns: 1fr; } .admin-form-grid { grid-template-columns: repeat(2, minmax(0, 1fr)); } }
283	@media (max-width: 760px) { .admin-layout { display: block; } .admin-sidebar { position: static; min-height: 0; padding: 16px; } .admin-sidebar-note { display: none; } .admin-nav { overflow-x: auto; margin-top: 14px; } .admin-nav ul { display: flex; width: max-content; } .admin-nav-link { border-left: 0; border-bottom: 3px solid transparent; white-space: nowrap; } .admin-nav-link.is-active { border-bottom-color: var(--sun-500); } .admin-main { width: min(calc(100% - 28px), 1440px); padding-top: 20px; } .admin-topbar { min-height: 66px; padding: 12px 14px; } .admin-kpi-grid { grid-template-columns: repeat(2, minmax(0, 1fr)); } .admin-page-hero { display: block; } .admin-page-hero-aside { max-width: none; margin-top: 18px; padding: 13px 0 0; border-top: 3px solid var(--sun-500); border-left: 0; } .admin-form-grid { grid-template-columns: 1fr; } .admin-form-grid .field-group--wide { grid-column: auto; } .admin-check-grid { grid-template-columns: 1fr; } .admin-login-page { padding: 14px; } .portal-banner-region { width: min(calc(100% - 28px), var(--content-max)); } }

+import io

+

+
+

+
+BASE = "http://localhost:8000"
+ROOT = Path(__file__).resolve().parents[1]
+PUBLIC = [
+    "/index.html",
+    "/pages/ataskaitos.html",

+    "/pages/dirvezemis.html",

+    "/pages/admin/pranesimai.html",
+    "/pages/admin/sla.html",
+    "/pages/admin/nevalidus.html",

+]
+
+
+def wait_ready(page, delay=650):
+    page.wait_for_load_state("domcontentloaded")
+    try:
+        page.evaluate("document.fonts ? document.fonts.ready : Promise.resolve()")
+    except Exception:
+        pass
+    page.wait_for_timeout(delay)
+
+
+def login(page):
+    page.goto(BASE + "/pages/admin/login.html", wait_until="domcontentloaded")
+    page.evaluate("localStorage.clear()")
+    page.reload(wait_until="domcontentloaded")
+    page.fill("#login-username", "administratorius")
+    page.fill("#login-password", "admin")
+    page.click("#credentials-form button[type=submit]")
+    page.wait_for_timeout(150)
+    credential_focus = page.evaluate("document.activeElement && document.activeElement.id")
+    totp_visible = page.locator("#login-stage-totp").is_visible()
+    code = page.locator("#totp-code").inner_text().strip()
+    page.fill("#totp-input", code)
+    page.click("#totp-form button[type=submit]")
+    page.wait_for_url("**/pages/admin/index.html")
+    wait_ready(page)
+    return {
+        "totp_stage_visible": totp_visible,
+        "focus_after_credentials": credential_focus,
+        "landed": page.url,
+    }
+
+
+def color_tuple(value):
+    nums = [float(x) for x in re.findall(r"[\d.]+", value)]
+    if value.startswith("#"):
+        h = value.lstrip("#")
+        if len(h) == 3:
+            h = "".join(ch * 2 for ch in h)
+        return tuple(int(h[i:i + 2], 16) for i in (0, 2, 4))
+    if len(nums) >= 3:
+        return tuple(int(round(x)) for x in nums[:3])
+    raise ValueError(value)
+
+
+def contrast(a, b):
+    def luminance(value):
+        channels = []
+        for component in color_tuple(value):
+            channel = component / 255
+            channels.append(channel / 12.92 if channel <= 0.04045 else ((channel + 0.055) / 1.055) ** 2.4)
+        return 0.2126 * channels[0] + 0.7152 * channels[1] + 0.0722 * channels[2]
+    la, lb = luminance(a), luminance(b)
+    return round((max(la, lb) + 0.05) / (min(la, lb) + 0.05), 2)
+
+
+def control_audit(page):
+    return page.evaluate("""() => {
+      function visible(el) {
+        const cs = getComputedStyle(el);
+        const r = el.getBoundingClientRect();
+        return cs.display !== 'none' && cs.visibility !== 'hidden' && r.width > 0 && r.height > 0;
+      }
+      function name(el) {
+        const aria = (el.getAttribute('aria-label') || '').trim();
+        if (aria) return aria;
+        const refs = (el.getAttribute('aria-labelledby') || '').trim().split(/\s+/).filter(Boolean);
+        const refText = refs.map(id => document.getElementById(id)?.textContent?.trim() || '').join(' ').trim();
+        if (refText) return refText;
+        const labelText = [...(el.labels || [])].map(label => label.textContent.trim()).join(' ').trim();
+        if (labelText) return labelText;
+        if (el.tagName === 'BUTTON' && el.textContent.trim()) return el.textContent.trim();
+        if (el.type === 'submit' && el.value) return el.value;
+        return '';
+      }
+      return [...document.querySelectorAll('input, select, textarea, button')]
+        .filter(el => !el.inert && el.type !== 'hidden' && visible(el))
+        .filter(el => !name(el))
+        .map(el => ({tag: el.tagName, type: el.type || null, id: el.id || null, cls: el.className || null, html: el.outerHTML.slice(0, 180)}));
+    }""")
+
+
+def live_region_audit(page):
+    return page.evaluate("""() => {
+      const candidates = [...document.querySelectorAll('[data-role="status"], .analysis-message, .admin-form-message, #feed-status, [id$="-status"], [id$="-message"]')];
+      return candidates.map(el => ({
+        id: el.id || null,
+        role: el.getAttribute('role'),
+        live: el.getAttribute('aria-live'),
+        hidden: el.hidden,
+        text: el.textContent.trim().slice(0, 100),
+        announced: ['status','alert'].includes(el.getAttribute('role')) || !!el.getAttribute('aria-live')
+      }));
+    }""")
+
+
+def route_probe(page, route):
+    page.goto(BASE + route, wait_until="domcontentloaded")
+    wait_ready(page)
+    return {
+        "url": page.url,
+        "scroll_width": page.evaluate("document.documentElement.scrollWidth"),
+        "client_width": page.evaluate("document.documentElement.clientWidth"),
+        "fonts": page.evaluate("({available: !!document.fonts, status: document.fonts?.status || null, jakarta: document.fonts?.check('16px \"Plus Jakarta Sans\"') ?? null})"),
+        "unnamed_controls": control_audit(page),
+        "live_regions": live_region_audit(page),
+        "refs": page.evaluate("[...document.querySelectorAll('[href],[src]')].flatMap(el => [el.href || el.src]).filter(Boolean)"),
+    }
+
+
+def tab_checks(page):
+    out = {}
+    page.goto(BASE + "/pages/oro.html", wait_until="domcontentloaded")
+    wait_ready(page)
+    out["oro_structure"] = page.evaluate("""() => [...document.querySelectorAll('[data-analysis-tab]')].map(tab => {
+      const panel = document.getElementById(tab.getAttribute('aria-controls'));
+      return {id: tab.id, selected: tab.getAttribute('aria-selected'), controls: tab.getAttribute('aria-controls'), tabindex: tab.tabIndex,
+        panelRole: panel?.getAttribute('role'), panelLabelledby: panel?.getAttribute('aria-labelledby'), panelHidden: panel?.hidden};
+    })""")
+    first = page.locator("[data-analysis-tab]").first
+    first.focus()
+    keys = []
+    for key in ["ArrowRight", "Home", "End", "ArrowLeft"]:
+        page.keyboard.press(key)
+        keys.append({
+            "key": key,
+            "focus": page.evaluate("document.activeElement && document.activeElement.id"),
+            "selected": page.locator('[data-analysis-tab][aria-selected="true"]').get_attribute("id"),
+        })
+    out["oro_keyboard"] = keys
+
+    page.goto(BASE + "/pages/gyvoji_gamta.html", wait_until="domcontentloaded")
+    wait_ready(page)
+    out["wildlife_structure"] = page.evaluate("""() => ({
+      tabs: [...document.querySelectorAll('#wildlife-tabs [role=tab]')].map(tab => ({id: tab.id, selected: tab.getAttribute('aria-selected'), controls: tab.getAttribute('aria-controls'), tabindex: tab.tabIndex})),
+      panel: (() => { const p = document.querySelector('#wildlife-panel'); return {role:p?.getAttribute('role'), labelledby:p?.getAttribute('aria-labelledby'), tabindex:p?.tabIndex}; })()
+    })""")
+    page.locator("#wildlife-tabs [role=tab]").first.focus()
+    keys = []
+    for key in ["ArrowRight", "Home", "End", "ArrowLeft"]:
+        page.keyboard.press(key)
+        keys.append({
+            "key": key,
+            "focus": page.evaluate("document.activeElement && document.activeElement.id"),
+            "selected": page.locator('#wildlife-tabs [aria-selected="true"]').get_attribute("id"),
+            "panel_labelledby": page.locator("#wildlife-panel").get_attribute("aria-labelledby"),
+        })
+    out["wildlife_keyboard"] = keys
+    return out
+
+
+def multiselect_keyboard(page):
+    page.goto(BASE + "/pages/vanduo.html", wait_until="domcontentloaded")
+    wait_ready(page)
+    clear = page.locator('#water-sites + .multiselect [data-multiselect-action="clear"]')
+    clear.focus()
+    page.keyboard.press("Tab")
+    focus = page.evaluate("""() => ({tag: document.activeElement?.tagName, type: document.activeElement?.type, value: document.activeElement?.value, checked: document.activeElement?.checked, inMultiselect: !!document.activeElement?.closest('.multiselect')})""")
+    before = page.evaluate("document.activeElement.checked")
+    page.keyboard.press("Space")
+    after = page.evaluate("document.activeElement.checked")
+    mirrored = page.evaluate("""() => { const cb=document.activeElement; return [...document.querySelectorAll('#water-sites option')].find(o=>o.value===cb.value)?.selected ?? null; }""")
+    return {"focus_after_tab": focus, "checked_before": before, "checked_after_space": after, "native_option_selected": mirrored}
+
+
+def subscription_focus(page):
+    page.goto(BASE + "/pages/prenumerata.html", wait_until="domcontentloaded")
+    wait_ready(page)
+    page.locator('[data-check-group="districts"]').first.check()
+    page.click("#to-confirm")
+    page.wait_for_timeout(100)
+    confirm = page.evaluate("({tag:document.activeElement?.tagName, panel:document.activeElement?.dataset?.wizardPanel || null})")
+    page.fill("#subscription-email", "audit@example.lt")
+    page.check('#subscription-form input[name="consent"]')
+    page.click('#subscription-form button[type="submit"]')
+    page.wait_for_timeout(100)
+    verify = page.evaluate("({tag:document.activeElement?.tagName, panel:document.activeElement?.dataset?.wizardPanel || null})")
+    code = page.locator("#demo-code").inner_text().strip("[]")
+    page.fill("#verify-code", code)
+    page.click('#verify-form button[type="submit"]')
+    page.wait_for_timeout(100)
+    done = page.evaluate("({tag:document.activeElement?.tagName, panel:document.activeElement?.dataset?.wizardPanel || null})")
+    return {"confirm": confirm, "verify": verify, "done": done}
+
+
+def deep_links(page):
+    out = {}
+    page.goto(BASE + "/pages/oro.html#laboratoriniai", wait_until="domcontentloaded")
+    wait_ready(page)
+    out["oro"] = {
+        "selected": page.locator('[data-analysis-tab][aria-selected="true"]').get_attribute("id"),
+        "visible_panel": page.locator('[data-analysis-panel]:not([hidden])').get_attribute("id"),
+    }
+    page.goto(BASE + "/pages/gyvoji_gamta.html#pauksciai", wait_until="domcontentloaded")
+    wait_ready(page)
+    out["wildlife"] = {
+        "selected": page.locator('#wildlife-tabs [aria-selected="true"]').get_attribute("id"),
+        "panel_labelledby": page.locator("#wildlife-panel").get_attribute("aria-labelledby"),
+        "title": page.locator("#wildlife-active-title").inner_text(),
+    }
+    return out
+
+
+def nav_checks(page):
+    page.goto(BASE + "/index.html", wait_until="domcontentloaded")
+    wait_ready(page)
+    details = page.locator(".main-nav details")
+    monitoring = details.nth(1)
+    summary = monitoring.locator(":scope > summary")
+    initial = summary.get_attribute("aria-expanded")
+    summary.click()
+    page.wait_for_timeout(80)
+    opened = summary.get_attribute("aria-expanded")
+    geometry = page.evaluate("""() => {
+      const header = document.querySelector('.site-header').getBoundingClientRect();
+      const summary = document.querySelectorAll('.main-nav details')[1].querySelector(':scope > summary').getBoundingClientRect();
+      const menu = document.querySelectorAll('.main-nav details')[1].querySelector(':scope > ul').getBoundingClientRect();
+      return {headerBottom:header.bottom, summaryTop:summary.top, summaryBottom:summary.bottom, menuTop:menu.top, menuBottom:menu.bottom,
+        overlapsSummary: menu.top < summary.bottom - 1, overlapsHeaderBelowSummary: menu.top < header.bottom - 1, cssTop:getComputedStyle(document.querySelectorAll('.main-nav details')[1].querySelector(':scope > ul')).top};
+    }""")
+    link_count = monitoring.locator(":scope > ul a").count()
+    page.keyboard.press("Escape")
+    escape = {"open": monitoring.get_attribute("open"), "expanded": summary.get_attribute("aria-expanded"), "focus": page.evaluate("document.activeElement?.tagName + ':' + document.activeElement?.textContent.trim()")}
+    summary.click()
+    page.locator("main").click(position={"x": 5, "y": 5})
+    page.wait_for_timeout(50)
+    outside = {"open": monitoring.get_attribute("open"), "expanded": summary.get_attribute("aria-expanded")}
+    return {"initial": initial, "opened": opened, "geometry": geometry, "monitoring_links": link_count, "escape": escape, "outside": outside}
+
+
+def zoom_checks(page):
+    out = {}
+    page.goto(BASE + "/index.html", wait_until="domcontentloaded")
+    wait_ready(page)
+    page.evaluate("document.body.style.zoom='1.5'")
+    page.wait_for_timeout(100)
+    out["index_map"] = page.evaluate("""() => {
+      const host=document.querySelector('.map-preview'); const hr=host.getBoundingClientRect();
+      const nodes=[...host.querySelectorAll('.map-preview-content,.map-preview-label,.map-preview .lede,.map-preview-link')];
+      return {host:{w:hr.width,h:hr.height,scrollW:host.scrollWidth,scrollH:host.scrollHeight,clientW:host.clientWidth,clientH:host.clientHeight}, children:nodes.map(el=>{const r=el.getBoundingClientRect();return {cls:el.className,top:r.top,bottom:r.bottom,left:r.left,right:r.right,withinV:r.top>=hr.top-1&&r.bottom<=hr.bottom+1,withinH:r.left>=hr.left-1&&r.right<=hr.right+1,scrollW:el.scrollWidth,clientW:el.clientWidth,scrollH:el.scrollHeight,clientH:el.clientHeight};})};
+    }""")
+    page.evaluate("document.body.style.zoom='' ")
+    for name in ["vanduo", "oro"]:
+        page.goto(BASE + f"/pages/{name}.html", wait_until="domcontentloaded")
+        wait_ready(page)
+        page.evaluate("document.body.style.zoom='1.5'")
+        page.wait_for_timeout(80)
+        out[name] = page.evaluate("""() => [...document.querySelectorAll('.multiselect')].map(root => ({
+          id: root.previousElementSibling?.id || null,
+          root:{scrollW:root.scrollWidth,clientW:root.clientWidth},
+          list:{scrollW:root.querySelector('.multiselect__list').scrollWidth,clientW:root.querySelector('.multiselect__list').clientWidth},
+          rows:[...root.querySelectorAll('.multiselect__option')].map(row=>({scrollW:row.scrollWidth,clientW:row.clientWidth,scrollH:row.scrollHeight,clientH:row.clientHeight,textScrollW:row.querySelector('.multiselect__option-text').scrollWidth,textClientW:row.querySelector('.multiselect__option-text').clientWidth,textScrollH:row.querySelector('.multiselect__option-text').scrollHeight,textClientH:row.querySelector('.multiselect__option-text').clientHeight}))
+        }))""")
+        page.evaluate("document.body.style.zoom='' ")
+    return out
+
+
+def contrast_checks(page):
+    page.goto(BASE + "/index.html", wait_until="domcontentloaded")
+    wait_ready(page)
+    values = page.evaluate("""() => {
+      const root = getComputedStyle(document.documentElement);
+      const names=['--ink-500','--surface','--surface-muted','--sea-950','--shore-100','--good','--fair','--moderate','--poor','--very-poor','--extremely-poor','--no-data','--status-ink','--ink-950'];
+      const tokens=Object.fromEntries(names.map(n=>[n,root.getPropertyValue(n).trim()]));
+      const holder=document.createElement('div'); holder.style.cssText='position:fixed;left:-9999px;top:0';
+      const classes=['status-good','status-fair','status-moderate','status-poor','status-very-poor','status-extremely-poor','status-no-data','admin-status-ok','admin-status-warn','admin-status-danger','admin-status-muted','protocol-chip'];
+      classes.forEach(c=>{const el=document.createElement('span');el.className=(c.startsWith('status-')?'status-chip ':'admin-chip ')+c;el.textContent=c;holder.append(el)});document.body.append(holder);
+      const pairs=[...holder.children].map(el=>({class:el.className,color:getComputedStyle(el).color,background:getComputedStyle(el).backgroundColor}));
+      holder.remove();
+      const footer=document.querySelector('.site-footer');const link=footer.querySelector('a');
+      return {tokens,pairs,footer:{color:getComputedStyle(link).color,background:getComputedStyle(footer).backgroundColor}};
+    }""")
+    page.hover(".site-footer a")
+    page.wait_for_timeout(240)
+    values["footer"]["hover"] = page.eval_on_selector(".site-footer a", "el=>getComputedStyle(el).color")
+    values["ratios"] = {
+        "ink500_surface": contrast(values["tokens"]["--ink-500"], values["tokens"]["--surface"]),
+        "ink500_surface_muted": contrast(values["tokens"]["--ink-500"], values["tokens"]["--surface-muted"]),
+        "footer": contrast(values["footer"]["color"], values["footer"]["background"]),
+        "footer_hover": contrast(values["footer"]["hover"], values["footer"]["background"]),
+    }
+    for pair in values["pairs"]:
+        values["ratios"][pair["class"]] = contrast(pair["color"], pair["background"])
+    return values
+
+
+def chart_checks(page):
+    routes = {
+        "analysis-oro": ("/pages/oro.html", "#air-parameter"),
+        "analysis-noise": ("/pages/truksmas.html", "#noise-parameter"),
+        "periodic-soil": ("/pages/dirvezemis.html", "#soil-parameter"),
+        "periodic-water": ("/pages/vanduo.html", "#water-parameter"),
+        "wildlife": ("/pages/gyvoji_gamta.html", None),
+        "greenery": ("/pages/zeldynai.html", "#greenery-parameter"),
+        "reports": ("/pages/ataskaitos.html", None),
+    }
+    out = {}
+    for name, (route, selector) in routes.items():
+        page.goto(BASE + route, wait_until="domcontentloaded")
+        wait_ready(page)
+        if selector and page.locator(selector).count() and page.locator(selector + " option").count() > 1:
+            page.locator(selector).select_option(index=1)
+        elif name == "wildlife":
+            page.locator("#wildlife-tabs [role=tab]").nth(2).click()
+        elif name == "reports":
+            page.locator('[data-report-year="2024"]').click()
+        page.wait_for_timeout(300)

+import io
+import json
+import sys
+
+from playwright.sync_api import sync_playwright

+sys.stdout = io.TextIOWrapper(sys.stdout.buffer, encoding="utf-8")
+BASE = "http://localhost:8000"
+
+
+def wait(page):
+    page.wait_for_load_state("domcontentloaded")
+    page.wait_for_timeout(700)
+
+
+def login(page):
+    page.goto(BASE + "/pages/admin/login.html")
+    page.fill("#login-username", "administratorius")
+    page.fill("#login-password", "admin")
+    page.click("#credentials-form button")
+    page.wait_for_timeout(100)
+    page.fill("#totp-input", page.locator("#totp-code").inner_text())
+    page.click("#totp-form button")
+    page.wait_for_url("**/pages/admin/index.html")
+    wait(page)
+
+
+with sync_playwright() as pw:
+    browser = pw.chromium.launch(headless=True)
+    context = browser.new_context(viewport={"width": 390, "height": 844})
+    page = context.new_page()
+    page.goto(BASE + "/index.html")
+    page.evaluate("localStorage.clear()")
+    page.reload()
+    wait(page)
+    home = page.evaluate("""() => ({
+      aqiText: document.querySelector('.aqi-layout')?.innerText,
+      footerHref: document.querySelector('.footer-links a')?.href
+    })""")
+
+    page.goto(BASE + "/pages/prenumerata.html")
+    wait(page)
+    page.locator('[data-check-group="districts"]').first.check()
+    page.click("#to-confirm")
+    page.fill("#subscription-email", "audit2@example.lt")
+    page.check('[name="consent"]')
+    page.click('#subscription-form button[type="submit"]')
+    code = page.locator("#demo-code").inner_text().strip("[]")
+    page.fill("#verify-code", code)
+    page.click('#verify-form button[type="submit"]')
+    stored = page.evaluate("JSON.parse(localStorage.getItem('kms-amis-demo-subscriptions-v1'))")
+
+    login(page)
+    page.goto(BASE + "/pages/admin/prenumeratos.html")
+    wait(page)
+    row = page.locator("#subscriber-table tr", has_text="audit2@example.lt")
+    subscription = {
+        "stored_status": stored[0]["status"],
+        "admin_row_found": row.count(),
+        "admin_status": row.locator(".admin-chip").inner_text() if row.count() else None,
+    }
+    page.goto(BASE + "/pages/admin/index.html")
+    wait(page)
+    subscription["dashboard_kpi"] = page.locator("#kpi-subscribers").inner_text()
+
+    overflow = {}
+    for name in ["index", "sla"]:
+        page.goto(BASE + f"/pages/admin/{name}.html")
+        wait(page)
+        overflow[name] = page.evaluate("""() => {
+          const vw=document.documentElement.clientWidth;

+            boxes[sel]=[...document.querySelectorAll(sel)].slice(0,4).map(el=>{const r=el.getBoundingClientRect();return {left:Math.round(r.left),right:Math.round(r.right),width:Math.round(r.width),scrollW:el.scrollWidth,clientW:el.clientWidth,overflowX:getComputedStyle(el).overflowX,minWidth:getComputedStyle(el).minWidth};});
+          });

+            const cs=getComputedStyle(el),r=el.getBoundingClientRect();
+            return cs.display!=='none' && r.width>0 && (r.right>vw+1 || r.left<-1);
+          }).map(el=>{const r=el.getBoundingClientRect();return {tag:el.tagName,id:el.id||null,cls:String(el.className||'').slice(0,100),left:Math.round(r.left),right:Math.round(r.right),width:Math.round(r.width),scrollW:el.scrollWidth,clientW:el.clientWidth,overflowX:getComputedStyle(el).overflowX};});
+          return {doc:[document.documentElement.scrollWidth,vw], boxes, offenders:items.sort((a,b)=>b.right-a.right).slice(0,8)};
+        }""")
+    print(json.dumps({"home": home, "subscription": subscription, "overflow": overflow}, ensure_ascii=False, indent=2))

Tik tada įveskite el. paštą ir duokite aiškų sutikimą.</p><p>Patvirtinus formą, įveskite ekrane skliaustuose parodytą demo kodą. Prenumeratą galite ištrinti įrašę tą patį el. paštą ištrynimo laukelyje.</p></article></div><h2>Prieinamumo patarimai</h2><ul><li>Tab klavišu pereikite per valdiklius; aktyvus elementas turi mėlyną fokusą.</li><li>Grafikų duomenys pakartojami lentelėse arba suvestinėse po grafiku.</li><li>Mažesniame ekrane meniu slenka horizontaliai, o analizės blokai persirikiuoja į vieną stulpelį.</li><li>Įjungus sumažinto judesio nustatymą, perėjimai ir slinkimas sutrumpinami.</li></ul></section></div></main><footer class="site-footer"><div class="site-footer-inner"><div><strong>Klaipėdos miesto savivaldybė · KMS AMIS</strong><p>Demonstracinė naudotojo vadovo versija.</p></div><nav class="footer-links" aria-label="Poraštės nuorodos"><a href="admin/index.html">Valdymo pultas (demonstracija)</a><a href="privatumo-politika.html">Privatumo politika</a><a href="slapuku-politika.html">Slapukų politika</a><a href="bendra-info.html">Bendra informacija</a><a href="zemelapis.html">Žemėlapis</a></nav></div></footer><script type="module" src="../js/main.js"></script></body></html>

+def wait_ready(page, delay=650):
+    page.wait_for_load_state("domcontentloaded")
+    try:
+        page.evaluate("document.fonts ? document.fonts.ready : Promise.resolve()")
+    except Exception:
+        pass
+    page.wait_for_timeout(delay)

+def login(page):
+    page.goto(BASE + "/pages/admin/login.html", wait_until="domcontentloaded")
+    page.evaluate("localStorage.clear()")
+    page.reload(wait_until="domcontentloaded")
+    page.fill("#login-username", "administratorius")
+    page.fill("#login-password", "admin")
+    page.click("#credentials-form button[type=submit]")
+    page.wait_for_timeout(150)
+    credential_focus = page.evaluate("document.activeElement && document.activeElement.id")

+        "totp_stage_visible": totp_visible,
+        "focus_after_credentials": credential_focus,

+
+def color_tuple(value):
+    nums = [float(x) for x in re.findall(r"[\d.]+", value)]
+    if value.startswith("#"):
+        h = value.lstrip("#")
+        if len(h) == 3:
+            h = "".join(ch * 2 for ch in h)
+        return tuple(int(h[i:i + 2], 16) for i in (0, 2, 4))
+    if len(nums) >= 3:
+        return tuple(int(round(x)) for x in nums[:3])
+    raise ValueError(value)
+
+
+def contrast(a, b):
+    def luminance(value):
+        channels = []
+        for component in color_tuple(value):
+            channel = component / 255
+            channels.append(channel / 12.92 if channel <= 0.04045 else ((channel + 0.055) / 1.055) ** 2.4)
+        return 0.2126 * channels[0] + 0.7152 * channels[1] + 0.0722 * channels[2]
+    la, lb = luminance(a), luminance(b)
+    return round((max(la, lb) + 0.05) / (min(la, lb) + 0.05), 2)
+
+
+def control_audit(page):
+    return page.evaluate("""() => {
+      function visible(el) {
+        const cs = getComputedStyle(el);
+        const r = el.getBoundingClientRect();
+        return cs.display !== 'none' && cs.visibility !== 'hidden' && r.width > 0 && r.height > 0;
+      }
+      function name(el) {
+        const aria = (el.getAttribute('aria-label') || '').trim();
+        if (aria) return aria;
+        const refs = (el.getAttribute('aria-labelledby') || '').trim().split(/\s+/).filter(Boolean);
+        const refText = refs.map(id => document.getElementById(id)?.textContent?.trim() || '').join(' ').trim();
+        if (refText) return refText;
+        const labelText = [...(el.labels || [])].map(label => label.textContent.trim()).join(' ').trim();
+        if (labelText) return labelText;
+        if (el.tagName === 'BUTTON' && el.textContent.trim()) return el.textContent.trim();
+        if (el.type === 'submit' && el.value) return el.value;
+        return '';
+      }
+      return [...document.querySelectorAll('input, select, textarea, button')]
+        .filter(el => !el.inert && el.type !== 'hidden' && visible(el))
+        .filter(el => !name(el))
+        .map(el => ({tag: el.tagName, type: el.type || null, id: el.id || null, cls: el.className || null, html: el.outerHTML.slice(0, 180)}));
+    }""")
+
+
+def live_region_audit(page):

+      return candidates.map(el => ({
+        id: el.id || null,
+        role: el.getAttribute('role'),
+        live: el.getAttribute('aria-live'),
+        hidden: el.hidden,
+        text: el.textContent.trim().slice(0, 100),
+        announced: ['status','alert'].includes(el.getAttribute('role')) || !!el.getAttribute('aria-live')
+      }));
+    }""")
+
+

+    }

+      const tokens=Object.fromEntries(names.map(n=>[n,root.getPropertyValue(n).trim()]));
